entities.summary: Tanzimat, a notable figure in the history of Syria, associated with Late Ottoman Reform and Arab Awakening (1831–1860). Preceded by Egyptian Occupation and Tanzimat. Their legacy influenced Arab Revolt and Faisal and Arab forces enter Damascus.
